test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations oversees the Kutiyattam Kendra located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Culture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Kutiyattam Kendra, located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, is an institution established for the preservation and promotion of **Kutiyattam**, the Sanskrit theatrical tradition of Kerala.
 
• It is under the purview of the **Ministry of Culture**, Government of India, which oversees and funds initiatives to promote India's intangible cultural heritage.
 
• Kutiyattam is recognized as a **UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity** due to its historical and cultural significance as one of the oldest surviving forms of Sanskrit theatre.
 
• The Kutiyattam Kendra plays a vital role in training new artists, organizing performances, and conducting research to preserve this ancient art form.
 
• The Ministry of Culture supports various zonal cultural centers and institutions like Kutiyattam Kendra to safeguard and promote traditional art forms across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala Tourism Department**

 
 
• The Kerala Tourism Department is responsible for promoting tourism in the state of Kerala.
 
• It focuses on showcasing Kerala's natural beauty, cultural heritage, and wellness tourism, such as Ayurveda.
 
• Though it supports cultural initiatives, it does not oversee Kutiyattam Kendra, as it falls under the Ministry of Culture.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Education**
 
 
• The Ministry of Education is primarily concerned with policy formulation and implementation related to education in India.
 
• It oversees institutions such as schools, colleges, and universities, ensuring quality education and promoting literacy.
 
• It does not directly involve itself in the promotion of cultural or heritage art forms like Kutiyattam.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO**
 
 
• UNESCO (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) works globally to preserve cultural and natural heritage.
 
• It recognized Kutiyattam as an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2001, bringing international attention to this ancient art form.
 
• However, UNESCO does not manage or oversee the functioning of Kutiyattam Kendra; it only provides recognition and advocacy.
